name: k5_mr_trick_balloon
purpose: Magic Room is up (no Gravity) and Alakazam (Sitrus Berry) switches items with Kingambit (Air Balloon) on turn 2 and receives the balloon: setItem runs the balloon onStart, which prints nothing while the room is up (data/items.ts:191-195, ignoringItem), so the Trick -item lines are the only item lines. Kingambit shows its own balloon at the start (turn 0). Mud Shot hits the Alakazam holding the balloon while the room is up and Alakazam is immune once the room has ended.
